messages:
Jordan: Quick check — where are we on onboarding 'aruba-7b' into the catalog? We promised a launch next week; need final licensing ok + perf profiles and a canary plan.
Sophie: Quick thing: legal pinged me yesterday, they asked for source provenance and training data attribution. I can loop them in — who owns the intake docs?
Kai: I picked up intake metadata. I sent CLA & provenance to legal this morning (cc @Sophie). Perf preliminary numbers from a small P4d run: p50 token latency ~78ms for fp16, p95 ~210ms. We should run a quantization pass (int8) to check throughput improvements.
Marta: I can own evals if we give me the staging artifact. Need the model weights + tokenizer and the curated prompt set (summ/qa/intent). Also want the golden prompts for regression checks.
Ashok: I can do the canary on Dedicated. Need the manifest + docker tag + expected SLOs. Also confirm whether we’re enabling prefix KV cache for the canary config.
Jordan: Owners then: Marta -> evals, Kai -> licensing + perf bench, Ashok -> canary deploy, Sophie -> rollout playbook and legal coord. I’ll track the launch date.
Sophie: I’ll start the rollout doc now and add a checklist: legal sign-off, perf profile, canary pass, rollback plan, cost estimate. Can someone add a traffic policy? We should have fallback to 'redwood-small-2' if latency spikes.
Kai: Noted. Legal replied, they want clarification on "commercial use" in the model license (looks like CC-BY-NC). I flagged an email with specific use-case examples — waiting on their answer.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job/aruba-canary-1752109876 started by Ashok. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/1752109876/logs (will stream).
Marta: Ran evals against the prompt set on staging image `aruba:v2026-03-17`. Summary: majority tasks hold, but summarization ROUGE-L dropped ~3pts vs baseline. I attached sample cases and prompts. Suggest trying temperature 0.0 and then a small quantization run.
Ashok: Canary started on dedicated pool. Latency stable so far but seeing ~6% error rate on contexts >2048 tokens — stacktraces in the logs. Config snippet I used: ```yaml
model: aruba-v1
kv_cache: enabled
batch_size: auto
max_seq: 4096
```
Jordan: Blockers callout: (1) license text confirmation from legal, (2) investigate long-context errors, (3) resolve summarization regression or mark as known quality delta. Targeting Wed launch; if two of three unresolved, move to Fri.
Sophie: I added the traffic policy fragment to the doc and linked a fallback route. Also created the rollout PR: https://git.internal.redwood/rollouts/aruba-launch/pull/12
Kai: I’ll follow up with legal and post the clarification thread here by EOD. Also scheduling a quantization bench on a8g tomorrow to compare fp16 vs int8.
Marta: Uploaded eval artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/models/aruba/evals/1752109876 — includes failed case examples and scripts.
Ashok: Filed an infra ticket for the long-context stacktrace: INFRA-4381. I pasted the stacktrace and a minimal repro. Will start bisecting quantization flags if legal sign-off arrives.
Jordan: Thanks — next async checkpoint: tomorrow 10:00am PT. If anyone hits a hot blocker before then, please @Jordan + @Sophie in this thread and mark with :flame:.
Sophie: ACK, will ping infra owners if INFRA-4381 needs escalation.
Kai: :thumbsup: I’ll update here once legal replies.
Marta: Quick note — if we decide to accept the small ROUGE drop for this family, I’ll add an eval badge and a regression note in the catalog entry so product is aware.
Jordan: Good idea. Keep updates short in thread. Thanks team!
